**Finding: Compliant** (rule INSURANCE, § 18, ¶¶ p0074–p0075)

Section 18 already sits at our **preferred** position on every material term:

| Element | Preferred | Contract |
|---|---|---|
| CGL | 1M occurrence / 2M aggregate | ✅ matches |
| Professional / E&O | 2M | ✅ matches |
| Cyber / privacy | 5M (data processors) | ✅ matches |
| Workers' comp | as required by law | ✅ matches (plus employer's liability 1M) |
| Certificates | on request | ✅ matches |

The obligations run against Vendor (Brightline), and § 18.2 adds extras in our favour — primary coverage, advance notice of cancellation or material reduction, and confirmation that insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities. Coverage also survives one year past the term. No redline proposed.
